repos_data.description: Get up and running with Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.
User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
Powerful AI Client
The automatic work journal/time tracker. Privately turns your screen into a timeline of what you actually accomplished. Open-source and local-first.
AI-powered cross-platform e-book reader with semantic search, RAG chat, local vector store, notes, TTS, and WebDAV sync.
An open coding agent for your terminal, built by a community collective rather than a company. Bring your own model, keep your code on your machine, and owe nothing to anyone.

AI 小说创作软件：把灵感、角色、世界观、大纲、章节写作、审稿和修稿组织成可控流程；提供 Windows/macOS 桌面版，支持本地和在线模型。AI Novel Writing Software: Organizes inspirations, characters, worldbuilding, outlines, chapter drafting, review, and revision into a controllable workflow. Features desktop apps for Windows/macOS, Ollama integration, and a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin preview.
一款轻量级、跨平台的 Mini Kubernetes AI Dashboard，支持大模型+智能体+MCP(支持设置操作权限)，集成多集群管理、智能分析、实时异常检测等功能，支持多架构并可单文件部署，助力高效集群管理与运维优化。

The self-hosted AI studio: local video, image, music, voice, LoRA training, coding swarms, RAG and screen agents on one GPU, driven from the Studio or by your coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenClaw) through MCP and skills.
🤖 Visual AI agent workflow automation platform with local LLM integration - build intelligent workflows using drag-and-drop interface, no cloud dependencies required.
M-Courtyard: Local AI Model Fine-tuning Assistant for Apple Silicon. Zero-code, zero-cloud, privacy-first desktop app powered by Tauri + React + mlx-lm.

A simple, lightweight shell script to interact with OpenAI or Ollama or Mistral AI or LocalAI or ZhipuAI from the terminal, and enhancing intelligent system management without any dependencies(pure shell).
Self-hosted mem0 MCP server for Claude Code. Run a complete memory server against self-hosted Qdrant + Neo4j + Ollama while using Claude as the main LLM.
council of models for decision
MCP server for AI agent for cybersecurity: automate assessment of documents, questionnaires & reports. Multi-format parsing, RAG knowledge base,Risks, compliance gaps, remediations.

The whole local AI stack in one executable: it runs and manages local AI models across every GPU, and it's a search engine you can talk to, with cited answers from your files, code, and the web. MCP server for coding agents, web crawler, TUI, CLI, REST API, Python library. No Ollama or LM Studio needed, works with both.
Local-first AI PKM for coding conversations: import Claude Code/Cursor/Codex, distill notes, semantic search, tag graph, MCP memory.

Deep code indexing MCP server for AI agents. 25 tools: hybrid FTS5 + embedding search, call graphs, git blame/hotspots, build system analysis. Multi-repo workspaces, GPU-accelerated semantic search, 10 languages via tree-sitter. Fully local, zero cloud dependencies.
MCP server for Git with local Ollama — zero tokens for git operations
Private, local-first AI "life OS": any model per life-domain over a markdown vault on your machine. Council mode, open source (GPL-3.0).

npx @dotcomjack/grux | One agent for everything you run on your Mac. Opens terminal sessions it can undo, runs agent swarms, builds iOS apps, and writes its own next version for you to approve. 39 features, 116 tools, MIT, your key or a local model.

Embedded long-term memory database for AI agents & LLM apps. Six-layer cognitive architecture, knowledge graph, hybrid BM25 + vector search, sleep-time memory consolidation. One .meh file, zero infrastructure, pure Go.

ScribePal is an Open Source intelligent browser extension that leverages AI to empower your web experience by providing contextual insights, efficient content summarization, and seamless interaction while you browse.
Local-first knowledge graph for developers. Watches your files, builds a knowledge graph with LLMs, lets you query across projects.
Open-source, self-hosted knowledge backend for AI agents — hybrid search (vector + keyword), MCP server, 5 connectors, Docker-ready

The flight recorder for Claude Code. Persistent memory across sessions, hook-level capture of every edit, error and decision, and a bracket around /goal so an unattended run cannot poll all night, lose its record, or die silently. Nothing self-reported: the run report is what the hooks saw.
Open source LLM observability and monitoring. Drop-in proxy for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini with request logging, cost tracking, and agent tracing. Self-host with one Docker command. MIT.
Orchestration of autonomous, collaborative AI agents in Go — an idiomatic Go port of CrewAI.
Pull Deep Memory from across your Claude Code Sessions — when you need it.
Standalone MCP server — cross-session memory, 10-gate VERITAS build pipeline, cryptographic audit ledger, Cortex approval gate. Two files, one dependency.
Spend tokens on judgment, not typing. An MCP-native autonomous SDLC pipeline: frontier models plan and review, local models implement — engineering discipline on a $20/month budget.
Substrate-based context compaction for Claude Code. Inspectable signal weights, local-only, MCP-ready. Alternative to /compact + hook-based capture (claude-mem, etc.).
MCP server that offloads cheap work from your cloud LLM agent to a local Ollama model — summaries, drafts, extractions, first-pass reviews — at zero cloud cost.
Sovereign Ollama Bridge — MCP server for local and cloud Ollama models. Generated by Qwen 3.5 397B.

An MCP server (and a CLI) that lets an LLM query your databases in natural language through a business semantic layer — glossary, metric definitions, data dictionary, knowledge base, and example queries — grounded against your real schema.
Local-first document corpus pipeline for grounded AI agents
Zsh plugin: suggests a fix when a command fails, using a local Ollama model
